## Assumptions ([ASSUMED])

- brief.md: [ASSUMED] Platforms: web, responsive down to a phone (works everywhere; a desktop app can come later without a rewrite)
- brief.md: [ASSUMED] Data: local mode, saved in this browser behind the API contract (survives a reload with no backend; swap in a real API later)
- brief.md: [ASSUMED] Accounts: no sign-in for the first version (one device, one person)
- brief.md: [ASSUMED] Design system: the neutral starter, light and dark (passes contrast; swap in a brand any time)
- brief.md: [ASSUMED] Offline: the list works without a connection after the first visit because it lives in the browser; no sync (sync needs a server and a conflict policy)
- brief.md: [ASSUMED] Integrations: none (each adds a backend dependency)
- brief.md: [ASSUMED] Privacy: only the links the person saves, kept on the device; no analytics (nothing to consent to)
- brief.md: [ASSUMED] Accessibility and language: English only, WCAG 2.2 AA (the common legal bar)
- brief.md: [ASSUMED] Distribution: any static-friendly host, picked at release (fwos never deploys)
- brief.md: [ASSUMED] Minimum versions: the last 2 versions of evergreen browsers (covers most people)
- brief.md: [ASSUMED] Delete: undo for a few seconds rather than a confirm dialog (deleting a link is frequent and cheap to reverse)

- decisions.md: D-8 · 2026-10-07 · architecture · [ASSUMED] App ID: org.example.readinglist · Reverse DNS, locked now so a later desktop build keeps its identity · Example maintainer · Never, after the first release
- decisions.md: D-10 · 2026-10-07 · design-system · [ASSUMED] The neutral starter design system, light and dark, with the starter component set; no chart palette (no charts) · Passes contrast out of the box; swap in a brand any time ...
